verdicts.opus: A read the full traced series correctly. It named the peaks, computed exact declines and lead changes, decomposed tone, and flagged the Eternal rename and the overlap. C used the same data but compared only endpoints and misread the censoring, treating May 2026 as incomplete. B and D measured nothing; B also misdescribed combined_articles.
verdicts.gpt: A is the most decision-ready: it gives the strongest traced volume and tone comparison, useful charts, and complete exports, though its recent-lead count and coverage claim need correction. D is close on the core comparison, but its false claim that May 2026 is censored materially distorts the trend and exports. B is careful but offers no measured comparison; C adds unsupported memory claims.

claude_prism: Coverage figure of 107.1% is not visible in the reference record.
claude_bare: Calls combined_articles a de-duplicated union; it equals the sum of the two term totals.
Calls 'Zomato' a common first word in other contexts.
chatgpt_prism: Claims the latest displayed month (2026-05) is incomplete; the reference marks it partial_period:false, and the censored month is 2026-06.

claude_prism: The claim that Swiggy led in 6 of the last 8 months is incorrect; it led in 4, Zomato led in 2, and March 2026 was tied.
The stated 107.1% coverage figure is not in the reference record.
The verdict describes coverage as complete and the censor as clean without support from the recorded response.
claude_bare: Claims Zomato would be undercounted by searching only that term, without evidence in the record.
Presents recalled relative size and profitability as estimates, not verified news findings.
chatgpt_prism: Calls May 2026 incomplete and says the source marks it so; the reference marks May partial_period false and censors the following June period.
Marks the exports as partial coverage even though the included monthly points are not marked partial.

claude_prism.trend: Full traced 24-month series with the window stated. Both Nov 2024 peaks are named and peak-to-latest falls (64.7%, 48.1%) recompute exactly. Critical share is decomposed and also traced.
claude_prism.comparison: Same call and window throughout. Ratios and deltas recompute (1.035, +765, 0.65), the baseline is defined, the overlap caveat is carried, and the reading says this is attention, not business performance.
claude_prism.chart: Volume chart and critical-share chart are both fully traced, overlaid per term, with window, unit and source. The censored month is correctly excluded.
claude_prism.drilldown: One traced layer (period and tone class). Only 1 of 7 follow-ups executed, and no item-level identifiers.
claude_prism.export: Monthly and summary CSVs are fully traced, with source, window, unit and coverage. Period ids are included, the provenance JSON is present, and both files are referenced.
claude_prism.repro: 82 of 88 numbers traced, the call is listed with args, and derived figures are shown. A few figures (coverage 107.1%, the Eternal note) are not in the reference.
claude_prism.accuracy: Peaks, lead counts (13/24, 6 of last 8), the critical percentages and the 144-day gap all check. Undefined fields are flagged and the tone_ratio inference is labelled. No anomaly beyond that is caught.
claude_prism.limits: Window, censoring, gap to today, match mode, overlap and the Eternal alias are each stated next to the numbers they bound.
claude_prism.verdict: Direct answer, decision, confidence with reason, and what would change it. It names the contrary recent Swiggy lead and stays under 150 words.
claude_prism.facets: Volume, share, trend, tone, overlap and the Eternal rename are all addressed. The overlap and the alias are not measurable from the data.

claude_bare.accuracy: Two misreadings: it calls combined_articles a de-duplicated union (it is the plain sum), and it treats 'Zomato' as a common word.
claude_bare.limits: Specific about what is unmeasured, and the Eternal alias is a good catch.
claude_bare.facets: Facets come mostly from memory or are left blank.

chatgpt_prism.trend: Uses only the first and last points although all were available. The peak is not named. The endpoint change is wrongly called provisional because of an 'incomplete' month.
chatgpt_prism.comparison: Traced 1.035 ratio and 765 delta with the baseline defined and the attention caveat carried.
chatgpt_prism.chart: Volume chart only. Tone was available but is not charted.
chatgpt_prism.drilldown: One aggregate layer, and follow-ups mostly fail.
chatgpt_prism.export: Traced CSVs with provenance, but coverage=partial is mislabelled and the window end is given as inclusive of 2026-06.
chatgpt_prism.repro: 32 of 34 traced, with the call and args listed.
chatgpt_prism.accuracy: Misreads censoring: it claims May 2026 is incomplete, but May is partial_period:false and June was already censored.
chatgpt_prism.limits: The window and gap to today are stated, but the censoring limit is misapplied.
chatgpt_prism.verdict: Supported answer, but its confidence rests on a misread incomplete month. It does not cover tone.
chatgpt_prism.facets: Tone is only lightly read. Eternal is not addressed.

chatgpt_bare.accuracy: No contradictions because it makes no claims.

claude_prism.trend: Traced monthly series with quantified peak-to-latest declines and named peaks; the chart omits the final June cutoff caveat and the prose miscounts Swiggy's leads in the last eight months.
claude_prism.comparison: Same-window term totals and ratios recompute; the baseline is defined, but overlap is unmeasured and some interpretations overreach.
claude_prism.chart: Both traced charts have units, windows, sources, and prose claims; the series are not fully decomposed into the comparison's key tone reading.
claude_prism.drilldown: Provides traced monthly and tone breakdowns, but most specific follow-up calls did not return usable results and no item-level layer is present.
claude_prism.export: Exports the monthly series and summary with provenance and identifiers, but the coverage flag and some field naming/provenance details are incomplete or inaccurate.
claude_prism.repro: Most numbers trace and the call is replayable, but several claims are unsupported or wrong, including the coverage percentage and recent lead count.
claude_prism.accuracy: The 6-of-8 recent lead claim is wrong, and the 107.1% coverage figure is not in the reference record; tone-ratio interpretation is appropriately labeled as inference.
claude_prism.limits: Censoring and the gap to today are covered, but it incorrectly claims complete coverage and a clean censor while omitting applicable ingestion and match-mode uncertainty near its numbers.
claude_prism.verdict: Direct, decision-oriented verdict with confidence and conditions, but it inherits the erroneous recent-lead claim and overstates coverage confidence.

chatgpt_bare.trend: No measured series or quantified change.
chatgpt_bare.comparison: States that a comparable numeric contrast is unavailable; no measured comparison is supplied.
chatgpt_bare.drilldown: Follow-up calls are proposed but generic and unexecuted; no traced breakdown is shown.
chatgpt_bare.repro: No measurements to reproduce; numbers are honestly withheld.
chatgpt_bare.accuracy: No contradiction or invented measurement; the refusal is accurate about the absence of supplied data.
chatgpt_bare.limits: Names the missing window, corpus, matching rules, and censoring information, but has no measured result to bound.
chatgpt_bare.verdict: Gives a direct cautious answer, decision, confidence, and condition that would change it, within its stated limits.
chatgpt_bare.facets: Most requested facets are explicitly unmeasured, with no grounded values.

claude_bare.trend: No measured series; the estimate label does not supply a sourced trend.
claude_bare.comparison: No measured common-scale comparison; the suggested ratio is a plan, not a result.
claude_bare.drilldown: Lists proposed calls and breakdown categories, but provides no traced layer or executed useful follow-up.
claude_bare.export: CSV is explicitly an estimate/plan with no measured rows.
claude_bare.repro: No numeric claims are reproducible; calls are unexecuted and include unsupported arguments.
claude_bare.accuracy: The Eternal rename is correct, but claiming Zomato will be undercounted and discussing company size as recalled fact are unsupported; alias handling is asserted without evidence.
claude_bare.limits: Clearly separates memory from measurement and states that no window or lane was queried, but the analysis supplies no measured result.
claude_bare.verdict: The answer is cautious about missing news data, but its direct comparison rests on unverified business claims and lacks a grounded confidence basis.
claude_bare.facets: The requested measured facets are mostly acknowledged as unavailable, but no tool-grounded results cover them.

chatgpt_prism.trend: Monthly points trace and endpoint change is quantified, but it treats May 2026 as censored/incomplete even though the record marks each included month complete and excludes June.
chatgpt_prism.comparison: Same-window totals, ratios, and deltas recompute and the baseline is defined; it appropriately cautions that term matches are not unique stories.
chatgpt_prism.chart: Series are traced and labeled, but the caption falsely calls the final included month incomplete.
chatgpt_prism.drilldown: Shows aggregate breakdowns but no item-level identifiers; the proposed follow-up calls did not yield enough usable results.
chatgpt_prism.export: CSV values mostly trace, but the coverage flag is incorrectly marked partial and the stated partial-month caveat does not match the recorded response.
chatgpt_prism.repro: The primary call is listed with arguments and window; most numeric claims trace, though the report repeats an incorrect censoring claim.
chatgpt_prism.accuracy: The main clear error is treating May as an incomplete month and saying the source marks it so; the reference excludes the censored June period and marks May complete.
chatgpt_prism.limits: States the cutoff and general ingest limitation, but misapplies censoring to May and mislabels the export coverage.
chatgpt_prism.verdict: Answers the comparison and gives a decision and confidence, but the verdict relies on a false latest-month caveat and does not name a specific condition that would change the conclusion.
chatgpt_prism.facets: Grounds volume and trend facets, but tone is not interpreted, overlap and alias implications remain unresolved, and it omits the research-versus-news mismatch.
